title: Sticky Pistons Plus
description: Adds sticky textures to all sticky piston sides
body:
# Sticky Pistons Plus

Simple resourcepack that adds sticky textures to all sticky piston sides. So now you can see is it a regular piston or a sticky.

May not be compatible with some others resourcepacks.
